title: dorstenia riedeliana
intro: Dorstenia riedeliana, commonly known as a plant species of the family Moraceae, is a tropical plant native to the West African region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate conditions like fever, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Dorstenia riedeliana include its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit antiviral activity, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
